core_categories: Health and Supplements; Free-from and Real Foods; Natural Beauty and Skincare; Moms and Little Ones; Eco-friendly Home Goods
specialty_focus: Wellness Warehouse is a South African health and natural lifestyle retailer offering holistic health solutions, preventative care, and conscious living goods through physical stores and an online platform. It specializes in a Conscious Label Policy that audits product ingredients to ensure they are free from harsh chemicals, and prioritizes ethical and sustainable sourcing. It does not specifically deal in wearable medical devices.
